select lauj.update_time, lauj.update_user_id as userId, use.id as userId, use.nickname, use.username as userAccount, use.avatar, use.mobile from la_activity_user_award_record lauj join la_user use on lauj.user_id = use.id
and lauj.is_delete = 0
and lauj.award_id = #{param.awardId}
order by lauj.id desc
